svg.title: b1-promote-decline-then-accept
svg.desc: b1-promote-decline-then-accept: 8 steps over 1 day from 2026-02-01. Actors: a1 (agent, claude-code, answers dialogs: decline), h (human). elicitation decline, elicitation accept, CLI promote, tool forget refused. 1. [0d] a1 ingest # gRPC interceptors → $doc. 2. a1 remember Interceptors wrap every RPC in registration order. → $f1. 3. a1 promote $f1; expects 4 things. 4. a1 promote $f1 (dialog: accept); expects 2 things. 5. a1 search interceptors registration order; expects 2 things. 6. [1d] h promote $doc; expects 1 thing. 7. a1 forget $doc; expects 2 things. 8. a1 search auth interceptor before logging; expects 2 things.
